name: Dense-to-Sparse Voxel Octree Conversion
definition: A method to convert a fixed-size dense 3D voxel grid into a sparse octree structure by recursively hashing child nodes to detect and merge identical subtrees, thereby reducing memory usage.
summary: Dense-to-Sparse Voxel Octree Conversion transforms dense voxel grids into sparse octrees via recursive hashing and exact structural deduplication, distinguishing itself from tolerance-based fusion and explicit pointer sharing methods.
